notes: MAINT-MAPS stories defined (schema, logic, UI, integration, tests).

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for map provider data
Added core logic for provider-to-map transformation
Added UI rendering story for interactive map
Added integration with provider search results
Added test suite for map functionality

MAINT-MAPS-S1.title: Define Map Provider Data Schema and Contract
MAINT-MAPS-S1.description: Define the frontend contract for rendering providers on a map including latitude, longitude, provider name, specialty, and identifier. Ensure compatibility with existing provider search outputs.

MAINT-MAPS-S2.title: Implement Provider-to-Map Transformation Logic
MAINT-MAPS-S2.description: Transform provider search results into map-ready marker objects including coordinate validation, deduplication, and fallback handling for missing geo data.

MAINT-MAPS-S3.title: Render Interactive Map with Provider Markers
MAINT-MAPS-S3.description: Implement frontend map component to display provider markers, support zoom/pan, and show provider summary on marker click.

MAINT-MAPS-S4.title: Integrate Map with Provider Search Results
MAINT-MAPS-S4.description: Bind map rendering to provider search results so that map updates dynamically based on user queries and search filters.

MAINT-MAPS-S5.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Test Suite
MAINT-MAPS-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests validating marker rendering, coordinate handling, user interaction (click/zoom), and synchronization with provider results.
